summary: Comprehensive testing of Hi Again path crossing discovery app completed. All 25 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI flows tested successfully including Landing, Login, Register, Dashboard, Feed, Crossings, Connections, Profile, and Premium pages.
passed_tests: Backend: Login rejection with invalid credentials
Backend: Login rejection for non-existent user
Backend: User registration with unique email
Backend: Get crossings with match_score and match_type fields
Frontend: Landing page loads with hero, features, CTAs
Frontend: Login page loads and form works
Frontend: Dashboard shows stats (crossings, people, locations)
Frontend: Dashboard shows recent crossings with match badges
Frontend: Feed page loads with My People/Explore tabs
Frontend: Create post modal opens with caption/location inputs
Frontend: Posts display with likes and comments
Frontend: Crossings page shows crossing cards with match scores
Frontend: Crossings page has search and sort controls
Frontend: Connections page loads with tabs (All/Pending/Sent/Connected)
Frontend: Profile page loads with stats and edit options
Frontend: Premium page shows subscription plans ($4.99/month, $39.99/year)
Frontend: Registration flow creates account and redirects to dashboard

test_credentials.note: Admin account created by auto-seed on startup

seed_data_creation: Database auto-seeds on startup with admin account, 15 sample users, locations, crossings with match_score/match_type, and posts
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features are fully functional. The proximity matching algorithm is working - crossings have match_score (high/medium/low) and match_type (moment/path/alumni/nearby) fields that display correctly on CrossingCard components. Auto-seed populates database on startup. Stripe integration is configured for premium subscriptions.

features_verified.user_auth: Registration and login working with JWT tokens
features_verified.dashboard: Stats display correctly (crossings count, unique people, locations)
features_verified.feed: Posts with images, likes, comments, My People/Explore tabs
features_verified.crossings: Path crossings with match scores and types displayed
features_verified.profile: User profile with stats and edit functionality
features_verified.premium: Subscription plans displayed with Stripe checkout integration
